scope: Existing deployment, aggregate-only operating reads, isolated synthetic identity/data-flow verification

tests: sharing withdrawal, reconsent, personal consent and roster movement fence old surfaces and preserve private life state
real loopback HTTP modern command reaches teacherOverview under the same account and produces zero language events
unlinked students reach only fixed enrollment routes with verified world identity
real SQL invite contains only a 128-bit token hash; explicit claim links existing roster and grants no consent or school role
only a currently assigned active teacher/director can issue and staff revocation cannot revive old tokens
a linked roster row is never reassigned; one account cannot claim a second roster row
Town activity requires separate opt-in, preserves one academy identity, and cannot become language evidence
care ownership, due date, state, idempotency and revision are stored under current sharing scope
Town opt-out and master sharing withdrawal hide old activities; reconsent never restores them
reproduces the missing v1 source before migration and new bridge is additive/private without retroactive collection
v1 completion and classroom use one stable account: personal consent, explicit share and unmapped expressions stay separate
same-account teacher assignment returns to WORLD and result returns to Workspace without importing the old v1 run as task completion
revocation, personal revision changes, class transfer and source deletion do not resurrect unbound summaries or old assignments
teacher proxy only exposes assigned classes and rejects learner scopes and arbitrary APIs
staff and teacher sessions coexist and logging out of either leaves the other authorization intact
synthetic.storage: Memory-only PGlite and isolated temporary SQLite
synthetic.transport: Local handler and loopback HTTP with synthetic identities and fake OAuth

identityInterpretation.notAConfirmedRuntimeDefect: The reviewed withAccount transaction creates the shared mapping on an eligible first authenticated account use; registration policy can require onboarding first. No production identity was linked by this verification.

excludedRealUserAcceptance: Teacher completes SYNK ID authentication using the auth identity assigned to the actual staff roster and confirms the assigned class
Teacher issues an enrollment code; the student previews and explicitly claims their own roster entry
Student chooses personal-learning, class-learning-sharing and Town-activity-sharing consents separately
Real WORLD work and permitted Town activity appear for that same learner in the assigned teacher view, followed by actual care workflow

initialAttemptLimitations.reason: Deployment checkout had no local PGlite package; existing installed dependencies were selected through per-process NODE_PATH without installing anything.

The selected WORLD tests depend on their first migration-initialization test. Filtering that prerequisite out caused three unconfigured-fixture failures. The prerequisite and those three tests were rerun together in world-focused-r3.tap and all four passed. Product code was not changed.
